Coram : S.B. SINHA*, CYRIAC JOSEPH
Uttar Pradesh Electricity Reforms Act,_ 1999 - s.24 - Electricity tariff- Determination/modification of- Held: In view A B of provisions of the Act as also regulations framed thereunder, C U.P. Electricity Regulatory Commission alone has exclusive jurisdiction to determine tariff - and/or alteration of tariff, the Commission must be approached - Tariff in terms of s.24(6) to be modified by licensee albeit in terms of direction issued by Commission, wheretobefore all D procedures laid down in that behalf in terms of the regulations are required to be complied with.
Decision Date : 19-12-2008 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 7433/2008 | Disposal Nature : Case Allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
